title: Maps and sets
description:
Write these with `HashMap`, `HashSet` and `BTreeMap`:

```rust
fn word_counts(text: &str) -> HashMap<String, usize>          // lower-case words: runs of letters and '
fn top_words(text: &str, n: usize) -> Vec<(String, usize)>     // most frequent first, ties alphabetical
fn group_anagrams(words: &[&str]) -> Vec<Vec<String>>          // groups in order of first appearance, words in input order
fn first_unique_char(text: &str) -> Option<char>
fn letter_histogram(text: &str) -> BTreeMap<char, usize>       // lower-case letters only, sorted
```

The tests need `use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap, HashSet};` at the top of your file.
hints: `*map.entry(key).or_insert(0) += 1` counts in one lookup; `or_insert_with(|| ...)` runs code only for a new key, which is how `group_anagrams` creates a new group.
Sorting a word's characters gives the same key for all its anagrams: `tea`, `eat` and `ate` all become `aet`.
